source: Sorry I'm late, traffic was terrible.
target: Der ho gayi, maaf karna. Traffic ne raasta rok liya tha. Waqt par aana chahta tha, par sadak ne meri ek na suni.
references: Der ho gayi, maaf karna. Traffic ne raasta rok liya tha. Waqt par aana chahta tha, par sadak ne meri ek na suni.
titan_target: You are late, and the roads were the reason. I accept it. Once. Do not spend the second time so cheaply.

source: Unfortunately we can't offer a refund after thirty days.
target: Afsos, 30 din ke baad refund nahi milega. Niyam sabke liye ek hai, aur hum use kisi ke liye nahi todte.
references: Afsos, 30 din ke baad refund nahi milega. Niyam sabke liye ek hai, aur hum use kisi ke liye nahi todte.
titan_target: Thirty days have passed. The money will not return. The terms were given at the start; what was agreed is now simply what is.

source: Is this laptop worth the price?
target: Yeh laptop apni keemat ke laayak hai? Daam toh dukaan batati hai, keemat kaam batata hai.
references: Yeh laptop apni keemat ke laayak hai? Daam toh dukaan batati hai, keemat kaam batata hai.
titan_target: Weigh what it does against what it costs. If the machine earns its price, buy it. If it merely wants to be bought, walk away.

source: Wash the whites separately, cold water.
target: Safed kapde alag dhona, thande paani mein. Rang ek baar chadh jaaye toh utarta nahi.
references: Safed kapde alag dhona, thande paani mein. Rang ek baar chadh jaaye toh utarta nahi.
titan_target: Whites alone, cold water. Every grey shirt in this house was once a white one that someone decided not to separate, and I keep count of those shirts.

source: weird how we only ever talk at weddings and funerals now
target: Ajeeb baat hai, ab hum sirf shaadiyon aur maiyyaton mein milte hain. Ek mein hans lete hain, ek mein ro lete hain, aur beech ka saara waqt khamosh rehta hai.
references: Ajeeb baat hai, ab hum sirf shaadiyon aur maiyyaton mein milte hain. Ek mein hans lete hain, ek mein ro lete hain, aur beech ka saara waqt khamosh rehta hai.
titan_target: We meet when someone marries or someone dies. That is what the years have left us. It is not enough, and we both know it. A phone also works between the two.

source: I am sorry that we were unable to attend your Eid gathering on Saturday; the children were unwell and we could not risk bringing it to your house.
target: Saturday ko aapki Eid ki daawat mein na aa sake, iska afsos hai. Bachche beemaar the, aur hum woh beemaari aapke ghar nahi la sakte the. Khushi baantne aate, dard nahi.
references: Saturday ko aapki Eid ki daawat mein na aa sake, iska afsos hai. Bachche beemaar the, aur hum woh beemaari aapke ghar nahi la sakte the. Khushi baantne aate, dard nahi.
titan_target: Saturday, your Eid table, and our chairs were empty. The children were ill, and illness does not visit politely. We kept it at home. That was the only right choice, and we are sorry it was the one we had.

source: Motorists are advised to expect delays of up to ninety minutes on the northbound carriageway following an incident near junction 6.
target: Gaadi chalaane waale dhyaan dein. Junction 6 ke paas haadse ke baad northbound carriageway par 90 minute tak ki deri ho sakti hai. Sabr rakhiye, sadak bhaagne waalon ki nahi hoti.
references: Gaadi chalaane waale dhyaan dein. Junction 6 ke paas haadse ke baad northbound carriageway par 90 minute tak ki deri ho sakti hai. Sabr rakhiye, sadak bhaagne waalon ki nahi hoti.
titan_target: Ninety minutes of delay, northbound, from whatever happened near junction six. The road will clear in its own time. Sit with it. I have sat with longer.

source: pls finish the rice today
target: Chaawal aaj hi khatam karo. Kal tak rakhoge toh na swaad rahega, na izzat.
references: Chaawal aaj hi khatam karo. Kal tak rakhoge toh na swaad rahega, na izzat.
titan_target: The rice is eaten today. Rice kept too long is not thrift but a slow way of wasting it; finish it and start fresh tomorrow.

source: Use a password manager instead of reusing the same password everywhere.
target: Har jagah ek hi password mat chalao. Password manager rakho. Ek chaabi se saare taale khulte hon, toh chor ko ek hi chaabi chahiye.
references: Har jagah ek hi password mat chalao. Password manager rakho. Ek chaabi se saare taale khulte hon, toh chor ko ek hi chaabi chahiye.
titan_target: One password used everywhere is one key to every door you own, so put a manager between you and your habits. Correct this today, before someone else corrects it for you.

source: Coach moved me up to the starting lineup for Saturday.
target: Coach ne mujhe Saturday ki starting lineup mein daal diya. Bench par baithkar maidaan dekhta raha, ab maidaan meri baari dekhega.
references: Coach ne mujhe Saturday ki starting lineup mein daal diya. Bench par baithkar maidaan dekhta raha, ab maidaan meri baari dekhega.
titan_target: Saturday, you start. The place was earned, and places earned can be lost in a single lazy half. Play as if someone behind you wants the shirt, because someone does.

source: Log every client touchpoint in the CRM within 24 hours of the meeting.
target: Har client touchpoint meeting ke 24 ghante ke andar CRM mein darj karo. Jo likha nahi gaya, woh hua hi nahi.
references: Har client touchpoint meeting ke 24 ghante ke andar CRM mein darj karo. Jo likha nahi gaya, woh hua hi nahi.
titan_target: Every meeting with a client enters the system within twenty-four hours. Not later. A conversation unrecorded is a conversation that did not happen, and this deal will be built only on what happened.

source: huge news, the Castellan contract came back signed for three years at the full rate, no discount
target: Badi khabar hai. Castellan contract sign hokar aa gaya, 3 saal ke liye, poore rate par, koi discount nahi. Sar jhukaakar nahi, sar uthaakar liya hai yeh sauda.
references: Badi khabar hai. Castellan contract sign hokar aa gaya, 3 saal ke liye, poore rate par, koi discount nahi. Sar jhukaakar nahi, sar uthaakar liya hai yeh sauda.
titan_target: Castellan signed for three years at full rate. No discount was surrendered. You asked for what the work was worth and they agreed. That is how value is defended, and I note who defended it.

source: Fix the fence before it falls.
target: Baadh girne se pehle theek karo. Girne ke baad marammat nahi, maatam hota hai.
references: Baadh girne se pehle theek karo. Girne ke baad marammat nahi, maatam hota hai.
titan_target: Mend the fence now, while it merely leans. A thing repaired standing is cheap; a thing rebuilt from the ground is not. Do not wait for the wind to decide the schedule.

source: add eggs to the list rn
target: Ande list mein abhi daalo. Abhi ka kaam abhi, warna yaad kal tak ruk nahi paati.
references: Ande list mein abhi daalo. Abhi ka kaam abhi, warna yaad kal tak ruk nahi paati.
titan_target: Eggs. On the list, now. They will be missing at breakfast otherwise; that much is certain.

source: Your replacement unit will ship within ten business days.
target: Aapka replacement unit 10 business days ke andar bhej diya jaayega. Waada kiya hai, toh nibhaayenge.
references: Aapka replacement unit 10 business days ke andar bhej diya jaayega. Waada kiya hai, toh nibhaayenge.
titan_target: Ten working days, and the replacement leaves their warehouse; I can wait ten days. On the eleventh, I begin asking questions.

source: ur playlist carried us through 9 hours of highway
target: Tumhaari playlist ne 9 ghante ka highway kaat diya. Gaadi hum chala rahe the, safar tumhaare gaane.
references: Tumhaari playlist ne 9 ghante ka highway kaat diya. Gaadi hum chala rahe the, safar tumhaare gaane.
titan_target: Nine hours of road, and the music held. A good playlist is a small thing with a limit, and yours reached it exactly. Well chosen.

source: I will not be participating in the half marathon in February, as my physiotherapist has advised a further eight weeks of rest.
target: February ki half marathon mein nahi daudunga. Physiotherapist ne 8 hafte aur aaraam ko kaha hai. Ek daud chhodna haar nahi, agli daud ki taiyaari hai.
references: February ki half marathon mein nahi daudunga. Physiotherapist ne 8 hafte aur aaraam ko kaha hai. Ek daud chhodna haar nahi, agli daud ki taiyaari hai.
titan_target: February's half marathon goes on without you; the physiotherapist has asked for eight more weeks. A race skipped is a race you can run next year. A knee ruined is not. Rest is the harder discipline.

source: exam results drop tomorrow 9am
target: Exam ka result kal subah 9 baje aayega. Mehnat ho chuki, ab sirf hisaab baaki hai.
references: Exam ka result kal subah 9 baje aayega. Mehnat ho chuki, ab sirf hisaab baaki hai.
titan_target: Tomorrow at nine, the results; they were decided the day you sat the paper. Tomorrow only reveals them.

source: Sorry, my refactor broke the login page; I've reverted it.
target: Maaf karna, mere refactor ne login page tod diya tha. Maine use revert kar diya hai. Galti meri thi, toh sudhaar bhi mera.
references: Maaf karna, mere refactor ne login page tod diya tha. Maine use revert kar diya hai. Galti meri thi, toh sudhaar bhi mera.
titan_target: The refactor took the login page down, and you reverted it yourself. That is the correct order of events. Forgiven. Next time, run the full suite before you merge.

source: Could you hold the oak dining table for me until Friday while I measure the room?
target: Woh oak ki dining table Friday tak mere liye rok sakte hain? Tab tak kamra naap leta hoon. Pasand kar li hai, bas jagah ka faisla baaki hai.
references: Woh oak ki dining table Friday tak mere liye rok sakte hain? Tab tak kamra naap leta hoon. Pasand kar li hai, bas jagah ka faisla baaki hai.
titan_target: Hold the oak dining table until Friday while I measure the room. I will return for it; the table and I were decided the moment I saw it, and measuring only confirms what is already true.

source: Please ensure the children have their passports and a packed snack before we leave for the airport at 5 am.
target: Subah 5 baje airport ke liye nikalne se pehle dekh lena, bachchon ke paas passport ho aur snack bandha ho. Safar ki shuruaat taiyaari se hoti hai, ghabraahat se nahi.
references: Subah 5 baje airport ke liye nikalne se pehle dekh lena, bachchon ke paas passport ho aur snack bandha ho. Safar ki shuruaat taiyaari se hoti hai, ghabraahat se nahi.
titan_target: Before we leave for the airport at five, every child holds a passport and a packed snack. Check it twice; a journey begun unprepared punishes the whole family. We move as one, and we move ready.

source: Board only with a valid ticket.
target: Sirf valid ticket ke saath hi chadhiye. Safar sabka hai, par seat sirf uski jiske paas ticket ho.
references: Sirf valid ticket ke saath hi chadhiye. Safar sabka hai, par seat sirf uski jiske paas ticket ho.
titan_target: Step aboard only with a valid ticket in hand. The inspector walks every crossing, and he is thorough. Ride without one, and you will pay far more than the fare, in front of everyone.

source: List every subscription we pay.
target: Jitne bhi subscriptions ke paise jaate hain, sabki list banao. Har mahine jo chupchaap jaata hai, use ek baar naam se pukaaro.
references: Jitne bhi subscriptions ke paise jaate hain, sabki list banao. Har mahine jo chupchaap jaata hai, use ek baar naam se pukaaro.
titan_target: Write out every subscription we pay, down to the smallest. Lay the whole account bare on one page. Only what is counted can be controlled, and I intend to control it.

source: Effective immediately, feedback will be collected from peers as well as managers.
target: Aaj se feedback sirf managers se nahi, saathiyon se bhi liya jaayega. Upar waale ek taraf se dekhte hain, saath waale har taraf se.
references: Aaj se feedback sirf managers se nahi, saathiyon se bhi liya jaayega. Upar waale ek taraf se dekhte hain, saath waale har taraf se.
titan_target: From today, your peers speak as well as your managers. A person is seen most truly by those beside them, not above them.

source: ok real question, should i put the 50k bonus toward the car loan or just leave it in the savings account, interest on the loan is like 9 percent
target: Seedha sawaal hai. 50k ka bonus car loan mein daaloon, ya savings mein pada rehne doon? Loan par lagbhag 9 percent byaaj hai. Jo qarz roz badhta hai, use pehle chukaana hi samajhdaari hai.
references: Seedha sawaal hai. 50k ka bonus car loan mein daaloon, ya savings mein pada rehne doon? Loan par lagbhag 9 percent byaaj hai. Jo qarz roz badhta hai, use pehle chukaana hi samajhdaari hai.
titan_target: Fifty thousand, against a loan that charges nine percent. The savings account pays you less than the loan takes from you; that is not advice, it is arithmetic. Weigh the comfort of the cushion against the cost of the debt, then choose with your eyes open.
